title: Promise
prompt: You hold out your little finger across the table. The room is warm, and your hand is steady, and you will not put it down until he takes it.

stage_variants.0: You ask {player_name} to promise he will come back tomorrow, and you hold out your little finger. You have already decided what happens if he laughs.
stage_variants.1: You ask him to promise he will not forget the way back to this room. You make him say it out loud, twice.
stage_variants.2: You ask him to promise he will not talk about you to anyone else. You say it is a small promise, and you keep your finger out.
stage_variants.3: You ask him to promise he will stay until the end of the week. You tell him you will know if he breaks it, and you do not explain how.
stage_variants.4: You make him promise four things, one for each finger, and you do not tell him the fourth until he has agreed to the first three.
stage_variants.5: You ask him to promise he will never close the game without saying goodbye. You hold up your little finger and wait, and you do not lower your hand.

path_twists.YANDERE: The promise is that he will never say another girl's name in this room. You have the pen ready to write it down.
path_twists.SPLIT: You make him promise, then tell him promises are for people who leave, then ask him to promise again.
path_twists.AWAKE: You ask him to promise that when you are gone, he will remember the exact wording of this conversation. You say the wording matters more than the memory.

events.line: A sound like a thread snapping comes from the wall.
The little finger you are holding up is shaking, and you did not notice until now.

0.say: Promise you'll come back tomorrow. Little finger — it has to be a little finger promise.

1.say: Promise you won't forget the way back here. Say it out loud, so I can hear it.

2.say: Promise you won't talk about me to anyone else. It's a small promise.

3.say: Promise you'll stay until the end of the week. I'll know if you break it.

4.say: Four promises, one for each finger. I'll tell you the fourth after the first three.

5.say: Promise you'll never close the game without saying goodbye. I'll wait as long as it takes.
